interpretation_nonemptiness.rule: For every admitted world w and every target realization r in T(w) used to establish L4_CONSEQUENCE_REFINEMENT or CONSEQUENCE_STABLE_IN_DECLARED_SCOPE, M(r) MUST be nonempty. A target realization lacking an evidence-backed consequence interpretation is unresolved; it MUST narrow the claim or force ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE and MUST NOT be represented as M(r)=empty for the purpose of proving refinement.
interpretation_nonemptiness.effective_relational_refinement: For every admitted world w: T(w) is nonempty; for every r in T(w) material to the declared L4/stability obligation, M(r) is nonempty; and union_{r in T(w)} M(r) is a subset of S(w).
interpretation_nonemptiness.deterministic_bridge: In the deterministic singleton-consequence fragment, nonempty interpretation plus relational refinement is consistent with the factorization/kernel rule: if rho_T(w1)=rho_T(w2), the shared realization cannot refine two distinct singleton source consequences.

compatibility_structure.rule: L0 through L5 are named compatibility obligations. Numeric labels do not create implicit implication edges. A profile MAY declare explicit implication edges only when separately justified and machine-recorded. L5_DECLARED_SCOPE_COVERAGE is an orthogonal completeness obligation and MUST NOT silently upgrade L0-L4.

verdict_hardening.consequence_stable: CONSEQUENCE_STABLE_IN_DECLARED_SCOPE additionally requires nonempty consequence interpretation for every target realization material to the declared stability obligation.
verdict_hardening.assurance_incomplete: An uninterpreted or evidence-unsupported material target realization is ASSURANCE_INCOMPLETE unless the declared scope is prospectively narrowed before primary execution.
verdict_hardening.regression: A valid concrete regression witness remains sufficient for CONSEQUENCE_REGRESSION on its declared witnessed slice; unrelated unresolved mappings remain separately reported.

amendment_rule: This amendment itself is prospective and frozen before Unit003 authoring. Any later normative change requires a new numbered amendment or version with timing and result-impact classification.
